one_line: Open with one first-person claim, then narrate the developmental point at the exact moment it shows on screen.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld, eye level: a toddler with a pacifier climbs the side of a foam cube by a sunlit window. Voiceover (transcript): "אם הייתי צריכה לבחור משחק אחד לבית מבחינה התפתחותית, זה היה הג'ימבורי של בליס". Subtitles start at 0:00.
q1_hook.why: A bold first-person pick, one toy for the home, states the value and names the product in the first sentence (H1, H2). Voice and subtitle start together (H6), with the toddler mid-climb in the first frame (S1). The brand is said once inside the claim (H3). No face, voice only (H4 partly).

beats.what: The toddler climbs the cube; subtitle "התפתחותית, זה היה הג'ימבורי של בליס"
beats.why: Claim, product name and action together

beats.what: He crawls onto the top; "תראו כמה קורה פה בפעולה אחת פשוטה"
beats.why: Asks the viewer to look closely

beats.what: Close shots of him on top; "בטיפוס במדרגות הוא עובד על העברות משקל"
beats.why: A skill is named while the climb is on screen

beats.what: He pauses at the top and looks out; "כשהוא מגיע למעלה, אני ממש לא ממהרת לעזור לו"
beats.why: The parent's patience is the human beat

beats.what: A new angle on the cushions; "ואז מגיע הסיבוב"
beats.why: A teaser line and a change of view

beats.what: He shifts his body on the slope; "הוא מארגן מחדש את הגוף, מעביר משקל"
beats.why: The skill the voice named is now on screen

beats.what: Over the ramp: "וזה בדיוק מה שאני אוהבת במשחק הזה"
beats.why: The verdict in her own words

beats.what: He reaches the bottom, a hand on his back; "אני יוצרת את הסביבה"; ends on the empty ramp
beats.why: The closing line states the lesson

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption ends "ואצלנו?" and then a recommendation, a rhetorical opener, not an invitation to answer.
q2_flow.why: A first-person claim, then a child climbing for 30 s with the voice naming each skill as it shows (R3, K4). "ואז מגיע הסיבוב" at 0:20 re-hooks (R3). The 0:09 to 0:20 stretch is one child on one cube, slow, with nothing new but words (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; the last subtitle is "הדרך נותנת לו לגלות". The caption ends with a recommendation, "ואצלנו? הג׳ימבורי הזה הפך מהר מאוד לאחד הדברים הכי שימושיים בבית", and asks nothing.
q3_cta.why: No ask and no next step: nothing says where to buy or how to ask (C6). Ending on the lesson is clean and uses no bait (C2). The cost is that a convinced viewer has no action to take.

q4_shown.what: A toddler climbs a foam cube, pauses at the top, turns and goes down a ramp (0:00 to 0:33). An adult hand on his back at 0:29, a second child at 0:30. The brand name is only spoken and subtitled at 0:03. No price.
q4_shown.why: Each skill named by the voice is on screen at that moment, so the claim is shown as it is said (K4, F8). A parent describing her own practice reads as vouching, not ad copy (S6, K5). The child's face and a second child are on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 3 to 4 handheld takes in 34 s, straight cuts near 0:20 and 0:29 (judged from the view), no speed change seen. Subtitles in short lines follow the voice every 2 to 3 s. Ends on the empty ramp at 0:33.
q5_edit.why: Takes of 9 to 15 s are slower than the 2 to 5 s in E2, but the child's own movement and the line-by-line subtitles keep it changing (E2, E4, T2). The voice leads with the claim, and the Reel ends right after the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A parent's developmental case for a climbing set: it trains weight shifts and planning while she lets her toddler find his own way down. Serves parents who want purposeful play.
q6_topic.why: A parenting stance (do not rush to help) wrapped around the product gives a reason to watch beyond the product (K4, K6). The developmental claims are modest and tied to what the viewer sees (K4). The mood is calm, with no peak, gift or occasion (K1, K7 not met).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone footage at eye level in a sunlit room with white curtains; close shots of the toddler on the cube, a wider view of the ramp. Strong window light, some glare. The creator is never seen; one adult hand at 0:29.
q7_filmed.why: Home, daylight and a moving handheld camera give a native, unstaged look (H8, F7). The child is large in frame and easy to read (F4). Backlit window light leaves him in shadow at times (F7). Subtitles sit at 72 to 77% of the frame, inside the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in white sans subtitles of the whole voiceover, two short lines, no box, centred at 72 to 77% of the frame height: "אם הייתי צריכה לבחור משחק אחד לבית מבחינה" (0:00), "התפתחותית, זה היה הג'ימבורי של בליס" (0:03), "תראו כמה קורה פה בפעולה אחת פשוטה" (0:05), "ואז מגיע הסיבוב" (0:21), "הדרך נותנת לו לגלות" (0:32). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "כמה התפתחות יכולה להיכנס במשחק אחד 🤍". About 45 words in three short paragraphs: a hook line, a list of skills (climbing, weight shifts, planning, strengthening), a personal line. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of the full voiceover let a muted viewer follow (T1), in short phrases (T2), but sit in the bottom 35% (T4) and white type on cream and beige is low contrast (T5). The caption opens with a hook and skill words, no hashtags, no disclosure words (T7, T8).

weak_points: No CTA, price or where to buy; subtitles in the bottom 35% with low contrast; a calm 34 s with no peak; the brand is only a spoken word and one subtitle; the creator never seen; children on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one unbroken handheld take of the book in use, hands only, and narrate the developmental point as it happens, with large subtitles above the bottom 35%.
not_verified: Music or other sound (cannot hear; the transcript holds only the voiceover). Whether the voice is the account owner's. The adult hand and the second child at 0:29 to 0:31 (not identified). Exact cut times (about 0:20 and 0:29 are judged from the change of view). Paid-partnership label: media info says 0; bliss.il is a coauthor. No correction to src/coded found.
